noticias.titular: A teacher measures the use of their apps with Umami, cookie-free statistics
noticias.entradilla: This tool shows which features students use without collecting names or email addresses.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: an app window with a pointer clicking sends its usage to a dashboard with a crossed-out eye; beside it, a cookie crossed out in red and a flag. Labels: App, Umami, No cookies, Error flag.

noticias.titular: Antigravity buckled under demand at its free launch; a year on, it has paid plans
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Google’s agent-based coding environment launched, free and overwhelmed. A year later it is on version 2.32, and extra usage requires a subscription.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych with two identical windows. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a window with a warning triangle and the label “Overloaded”. On the right, “Today”: the same window with a blue padlock and the labels “Weekly limits” and “Pro and Ultra”.

noticias.titular: Trama now has 245 reading texts in Catalan and Spanish, from the third year of primary school to the first…
noticias.entradilla: Trama now has 245 reading texts in Catalan and Spanish, from the third year of primary school to the first year of ESO, according to its own website.

noticias.titular: Three apps in Catalan: a classroom auction and two density labs
noticias.entradilla: Felip Sarroca i Gil shares Subhasta, for working on scarcity and budgeting, and Densitats and Densitat, for studying flotation with Archimedes’ principle.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, an auctioneer’s gavel on its block, with coins, labelled “Auction”. On the right, a tank of water in which a block floats, with an upward arrow labelled “Buoyancy” and the label “Flotation”.

noticias.titular: Agente Clima IES analyses classroom temperature and humidity in the browser
noticias.entradilla: The app reads sensor logs and compares them with the limits set by the regulation on workplaces.
noticias.imagen_alt: A document labelled “CSV” passes into a browser window, labelled “In the browser”, containing a thermometer with the label “17–27 °C” and water drops with the label “30–70%”.

noticias.titular: A robotic palletising cell is simulated in the browser and exports the scene as .glb
noticias.entradilla: According to the message of the person who shared it, the app was built with AI models; it lets users stop, resume and monitor a virtual industrial cell and export the scene for Blender.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a browser window with a robotic cell (conveyor with boxes, robot arm and pallet) and a vertical red line marking the safety curtain; a blue arrow towards a 3D cube. Labels: “Cell in the browser”, “Light curtain”, “.glb” and “Blender”.

noticias.titular: Trama offers 206 reading texts with questions for building reading comprehension worksheets
noticias.entradilla: The catalogue, in Catalan and Spanish, is aimed mainly at the fourth to sixth years of primary school and lets teachers choose the questions before printing the worksheet or downloading it as a PDF.
noticias.imagen_alt: Trama's catalogue of reading texts with filters on the left and cards showing an illustration, title, school year, difficulty and a “Prepara la fitxa” button.

noticias.titular: Chrome publishes Modern Web Guidance 1.0, a guide to the current web for coding agents
noticias.entradilla: The guide brings together expert-verified solutions and compatibility data to correct the outdated knowledge of models.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three boxes joined by arrows: a file with a clock, labelled “Old data”, an open book guide, labelled “Current web guide”, and a code file with a red tick, labelled “Current code”.

noticias.titular: Battleships in Catalan, against the machine or online with a room code
noticias.entradilla: “Enfonsar la flota” is a web version of the classic battleships game, with a 10×10 board, which works on coordinates and strategy in primary and secondary school.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen of the game with two cards: “Partida en línia”, with a button to create a room and a code field, and “Contra la màquina”, with three difficulty levels.

noticias.titular: Antigravity adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen and an Orchestrator mode that shares out the work
noticias.entradilla: Orchestrator combines Hydrogen with more powerful models; access depends on Google’s paid plan.
noticias.imagen_alt: Under the title “Orchestrator”, two boxes: on the left one with a branching diagram, labelled “Carbon plans”, and on the right one with a code file, labelled “Hydrogen edits”. An arrow carries the work from the first to the second and a red arrow goes back, labelled “If it gets stuck”.

noticias.titular: A teacher asks Codex to model Industrial Revolution machines in Blender
noticias.entradilla: Felip Sarroca i Gil says his computer cannot open Blender, but Codex can operate it, and it has generated 3D models for his website for fourth-year ESO students.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram from left to right: a speech bubble labelled “Request” leads to a cog labelled “Codex + Blender”, which leads to a cube with three dots labelled “3D model”; a curved red arrow, labelled “More realism”, returns from the model to the request.

noticias.titular: GeoBreath guides breathing exercises with geometric shapes and an adjustable rhythm
noticias.entradilla: Luis Vilela Acuña's app uses an animated shape to show when to breathe in, hold and breathe out. It opens in the browser, with nothing to install, and is available in six languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: GeoBreath screen with a square along whose sides a dot travels, the prompt “Inspira” in the centre, the session and cycle counters and the selector for shape and seconds per side.

noticias.titular: A web editor lets teachers design collectable fauna and flora cards for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: The Eco-Duel Card Generator, created by David Cordones, offers a form for composing cards with data on animals and plants, with one collection per school year, from the first year of primary to the second year of Bachillerato.
noticias.imagen_alt: Card editor with the form on the left and, on the right, a fauna card called Senglar with size 7, level 3 and speed 5, and the buttons Descarregar and Copiar above it.

noticias.titular: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper presented on 12 November, has a 3D simulation for…
noticias.entradilla: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper presented on 12 November, has a 3D simulation for preparing a NaOH solution and measuring the acidity of vinegar, according to its description.

noticias.titular: Conservatoire regulations, indicators and classroom games, new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: The Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository adds 25 resources this week: 13 are presented here and 12 have already had their own article.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home page of the Legis CPMDEM catalogue with a search box, filters for validity and categories of regulation, and the first entries for decrees and orders.

noticias.titular: Atlas en xogo, a map game in Galician, joins EDUmind’s apps
noticias.entradilla: A new interactive geography app in Galician has been shared in Vibe Coding Educativo. A full description of its game modes could not be checked.
noticias.imagen_alt: A browser window with a map and the label “Atlas en xogo”; to its left, a magnifying glass with a plus sign, labelled “Zoom”; to its right, a globe labelled “3D view”.

noticias.titular: Relleu Obert turns a piece of real map into a 3D model that can be printed for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: A free, open-source project lets you pick a place, generate its relief in the browser and export it for 3D printing.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three steps joined by arrows: a map labelled “Map”, a mountain labelled “Relief” and a printer labelled “Model”.

noticias.titular: A tool helps apply the order of priority in admissions to Valencian conservatoires
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created a website with diagrams, an age calculator and Excel templates for applying Order 8/2026 in music and dance schools in the Valencian Community.
noticias.imagen_alt: Page titled “Prelación de acceso a conservatorio”, with a tab bar (Outline, Timeline, Step-by-step guide, Age, Reorientation, Definitions, Templates) and four collapsible blocks of allocations.

noticias.titular: A Catalan-language website tells the story of the spice trade from Marco Polo onwards with maps, games and questions
noticias.entradilla: “El comerç de les espècies” offers nine interactive chapters, designed, according to its author, for secondary school and sixth-form students.
noticias.imagen_alt: A route with nine points running from a ship, labelled “Marco Polo”, to a globe, labelled “Today”; above, the label “Nine chapters”.

noticias.titular: Terminal or app: teachers compare ways of working with a coding agent
noticias.entradilla: The group discussed whether the terminal offers more freedom than the graphical app, and concluded that it depends on the person and the task.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three icons labelled “Web”, “App” and “Terminal” whose lines converge on a single box labelled “Result”.

noticias.titular: Reloj EDUmind brings together timers for the classroom, group work and independent study
noticias.entradilla: Luis has created an installable web app with three timer modes, designed for managing time in class from nursery to vocational training.

noticias.titular: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic advises that, to keep Fable 5.2 responsible for an action, you should write “ask for approval before deleting files” instead of “never delete files”, and reply with the specific instruction rather than a simple “go ahead”. It follows the guide the paper reported on.

noticias.titular: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual…
noticias.entradilla: The author of the school music bell has published their project on GitHub: an installation guide, a manual for the staff and the code, with an AGPL licence for the code and CC BY-SA 4.0 for the documentation.

noticias.titular: Anthropic recommends telling Fable 5.2 the code is its own if you want it to reorganise it
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic's guide to Fable 5.2 explains that the model behaves differently depending on who is named as the owner of the code, at a cost in tokens.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two columns: on the left, two identical blocks of code and the labels “Adds” and “Under 10%”; on the right, a merge icon above a single block of code and the labels “Merges” and “75%”.

noticias.titular: Eduvers brings together interactive Physics and Chemistry simulations and is preparing 3D virtual labs
noticias.entradilla: Its author is adding simulations to the website and announces that he will link 3D labs in the coming weeks.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three cards under the label “Simulations and labs”: the parabolic trajectory of a ball, “Physics”; a flask, “Chemistry”; and a 3D cube, “3D lab”.

noticias.titular: A music-class app asks students to place the notes of a score on the stave
noticias.entradilla: Pentagrama Maestro, created by Iñaki Fernández, plays note by note and offers three levels and unlimited games.
noticias.imagen_alt: A stave with four rising notes, labelled “Stave”, and an arrow leading to a loudspeaker labelled “Listen”; below, three bars of increasing height labelled “3 levels”.

noticias.titular: Tribunator organises panels, rooms and timetables for a conservatoire's entrance exams
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created, with the help of Claude, a tool that plans who sits on each panel, in which room and at what time they examine, and checks for clashes before anything is published.
noticias.imagen_alt: Tribunator welcome screen with the tabs Home, Space, Time, Templates, Panels and Verification, and the buttons Start from scratch, Import data and Load example.

noticias.titular: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the…
noticias.entradilla: Anthropic is giving plans that include Fable between one and three usage-limit resets, depending on the length of the subscription, which can be used until 8 March 2027; Pro gets one, only until 16 November. The model is Fable 5.2.

noticias.titular: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the latter only for verified organisations
noticias.entradilla: The company announces two versions of the same model: Fable 5.2, with safeguards and no prior verification, and Mythos 5.2, only for verified organisations.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of a trunk, “Claude 5.2”, that forks into two branches: “Fable 5.2”, which leads to a group of people labelled “No verification”, and “Mythos 5.2”, which leads to a padlocked closed door labelled “Verified”.

noticias.titular: Two Catalan-language apps by David Cordones: a letters and numbers game and a reception classroom
noticias.entradilla: Xifres i Lletres trains vocabulary and mental arithmetic by age; Aula d'Acollida Digital offers initial language support.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two panels: on the left, a calculator and three boxes labelled “Xifres i Lletres”; on the right, a translation icon labelled “Aula d'Acollida”; below, a dashed box labelled “Open source”.

noticias.titular: A website promotes Belsetán, an endangered Aragonese variety, with games and classroom worksheets
noticias.entradilla: “El aprendiz del pastor” brings together history, texts, games and teaching materials on the language of the Bielsa valley.
noticias.imagen_alt: A mountain labelled “Bielsa Valley” leads to an open book labelled “Belsetán”, from which two arrows come out: one to a pair of dice labelled “Games” and another to a document labelled “Worksheets”.

noticias.titular: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak…
noticias.entradilla: A free connector for Windows sends sensor data from a micro:bit board, over USB, to the ThingSpeak platform, useful for weather stations or vegetable gardens with charts.

noticias.titular: A planner lets schools build the school-year calendar from the official Valencian Community one or from scratch
noticias.entradilla: Calendari, created by José Luis Miralles Bono with the help of Claude, lets a school build its academic calendar in the browser, starting from the official Valencian one or from scratch.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home screen of Calendari with four cards: official calendar of the Valencian Community, create a new calendar, import from a file and view published calendars.

noticias.titular: A word cloud with a “backend” in a single prompt: today Claude’s new artifacts save data without being published
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, a word cloud built with Claude stored everyone’s votes from a single prompt. Today the new artifacts save data without needing to be published.
noticias.imagen_alt: A word cloud with a “backend” in a single prompt: today Claude’s new artifacts save data without being published

noticias.titular: Holmio turns the periodic table into a daily detective game
noticias.entradilla: Each day brings a new case with 118 suspects, the chemical elements, and six accusations to find the culprit; according to its author, no registration is required.
noticias.imagen_alt: A grid of squares imitating the periodic table, with the label “Case of the day” above and “One case per element” below; a blue magnifying glass points at one square. On the right, six circles, one with a red cross, labelled “6 accusations”.

noticias.titular: A calculator splits the working week of peripatetic teachers across several schools in the Valencian Community
noticias.entradilla: Itinerancias, created by José Luis Miralles Bono, calculates how the non-teaching hours are divided among the schools of a teacher who is shared between them, according to the teaching hours they give in each one. It opens in the browser, in Spanish and Valencian, and also offers an Excel spreadsheet with the same calculation.
noticias.imagen_alt: The “Tablas” tab of Itinerancias, with a selector for non-teaching hours and expandable sections on proportional and block allocation.

noticias.titular: Incluxat brings the guidance from educational psychology reports to the conservatoire
noticias.entradilla: An AI assistant adapts to music education guidance designed for mainstream schools, with its supporting documentation published so it can be reviewed.
noticias.imagen_alt: A document labelled “Report”, an arrow to a chat bubble labelled “Assistant” and another arrow to a piano labelled “Conservatoire”.

noticias.titular: A teacher replaces the school siren with a musical bell managed from a spreadsheet
noticias.entradilla: David Cordones says that, with the help of generative AI, he built a school bell on a Raspberry Pi that staff change from Google Sheets.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a spreadsheet labelled “Spreadsheet”, an arrow to a chip labelled “Raspberry Pi” and another arrow to a loudspeaker labelled “PA system”. Below the chip, a music file labelled “MP3 folder” and an arrow pointing up to the Raspberry Pi.

noticias.titular: An auction of phrases, a guide to responsible vibe coding, chemistry, music and illustrated books: new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: Since 27 October, the Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository has added sixteen resources: ten have already had their own article in the paper and six are presented here, two by Juan José de Haro, one by Felip Sarroca, one by FiQuiPedia and two by Samuel Soriano.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home page of Subasta de frases, with the buttons “Crear una actividad” and “Unirse a una sesión” and three cards: Conocimiento, Valores y prioridades, Roles y conceptos.

noticias.titular: EDUmind MiClase, an open-source teacher’s notebook, keeps data on the device and syncs without its own server
noticias.entradilla: Its author explained in the group how it syncs two devices and which features he says he has added to assess under the LOMLOE.
noticias.imagen_alt: A laptop labelled “Laptop” and a mobile phone labelled “Phone”, joined by a two-way arrow with a wifi symbol and the label “Same wifi”. Below, a server drawn with a dashed line and crossed out with a red cross, labelled “No server”.

noticias.titular: Luis Vilela Acuña released the open-source code of Liga de Valores, his app for school Physical Education…
noticias.entradilla: Luis Vilela Acuña released the open-source code of Liga de Valores, his app for school Physical Education leagues in which fair play, refereeing and the stands also score, with an installer to run it on the school's own network without an external server. He presents it in an article in the Revista Española de Educación Física y Deportes.

noticias.titular: Antigravity, Google's agent-based programming environment, has run cloud projects managed from the browser…
noticias.entradilla: Antigravity, Google's agent-based programming environment, has run cloud projects managed from the browser since version 2.29 (3 November), instead of on the user's own computer; according to its changelog, it is rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

noticias.titular: MechSimulator brings together free mechanical engineering simulators that run in the browser
noticias.entradilla: A group member highlighted this website of 2D and 3D simulations as an example of what one person can achieve.
noticias.imagen_alt: A browser window with a cogwheel, a ruler and a spanner, and a bending curve beneath them, labelled “In the browser”; an arrow leads to a grid of dots, one highlighted in blue, labelled “150+”.

noticias.titular: Fil i compte lets teachers prepare printable maths problem sheets in Catalan and Spanish, with an answer key
noticias.entradilla: A bank of 252 problems lets primary and lower secondary teachers pick problems, put them in order and print the worksheet or save it as a PDF.
noticias.imagen_alt: Screen of the problem bank with level, difficulty and content filters on the left and problem cards in Catalan on the right.

noticias.titular: An open project offers 54 interactive 3D science lessons for upper secondary school, in Chinese
noticias.entradilla: Tongjiang Lab brings together physics, chemistry, biology and geography lessons in HTML files that work offline; in the group it was pointed to as an example of what will be possible with AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: A bar divided into four sections of proportional width, under the label “54 lessons”; above each section an icon: an atom over “Physics”, a flask over “Chemistry” (the longest section, in blue), a DNA helix over “Biology” (the shortest) and a globe over “Geography”.

noticias.titular: A tool randomly forms the home and expert groups for the Jigsaw technique
noticias.entradilla: “Rompecabezas – Técnica Jigsaw” takes a list of students and subtopics and splits them into balanced groups. It opens in the browser and is available in five languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen with a box for typing students’ names, four colour-coded subtopics, a general topic field and the “Formar grupos” button.

noticias.titular: A block-based programming editor, built on TurboWarp and compatible with Scratch, for learning to code
noticias.entradilla: EduTicTac Blocs is a visual programming environment compatible with Scratch projects and with classroom templates; according to its website, it has no advertising or trackers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Example project with the “Ver dentro” button and the stage with its flag, pause and stop controls, a green start notice and the “Empieza con una plantilla” and “Explora la galería” buttons.

noticias.titular: A gamified activity teaches the gravitational field through nine orbital missions
noticias.entradilla: “Misiones orbitales”, by El profe de la bata, asks students to create an astronaut and complete nine missions using interactive simulators. The practice version runs in the browser, with no accounts.
noticias.imagen_alt: A planet surrounded by a blue elliptical orbit with nine dots, one per mission (“9 missions”), and on the right three stars labelled “All the stars”, earned with an error below 5% (“Error < 5%”).

noticias.titular: A Catalan-language lab lets students practise inorganic formulation with questions, hints and challenges
noticias.entradilla: “Laboratori de formulació”, created by Felip Sarroca i Gil, offers inorganic nomenclature exercises for Secondary and Upper Secondary students, with three working modes and a progress counter.
noticias.imagen_alt: Screen of the Practica mode with the question “Quina és la fórmula de: sulfur de bari” and four options (BaS, Ba2S2, BaCl2, PbCl2), hint and solution buttons, and on the right the list of activity types.

noticias.titular: FoQo generates organic formulation tests and gives the name of a drawn structure
noticias.entradilla: FiQuiPedia’s app lets users practise organic chemistry nomenclature with configurable tests and a tool that goes from formula to name.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen titled “Formulación Química” with the Tests, F → N and Panel buttons, IUPAC and CAS logos, links to libraries and a row of functional groups.
